state:
Goal `core-session` is reached. All 9 `Core\Session` features have every feature proof, and `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Session'` prints `nothing owed`, 27 examples and 9 attacks green. `bun nv verify`, `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes core-session` and `bun nv playbook --closes core-session` are green.

`Core\Session::start`'s card is in the plain voice, and its proofs follow the shape of `regenerate`'s: an `nvs.toml` beside the examples and the attack, a `.nvsr` beside each program. Its bench opens and ends a session each round, because `start` works once per session.

The proofs found one bug, fixed in its own commit: `CoreTy::classification` gave a `Nullable` parameter no mark, so every `?T` row declared `Neutral` or `Contagious` refused a `tainted` argument. `Core\Session::start(Core\Request::header(...))` did not compile. `tests/conformance/core/a-nullable-core-parameter-keeps-the-mark-of-its-type.nvst` pins the fix.
